user_requirement: Equal maximum training budget; prediction speed and accuracy are measured outcomes
initial_model_core_capacity: approximately 1.35M total coefficients; shared-interface capacity plan; record learned/fixed separately
learning_rate_schedule: cosine by fraction of time budget used, minimum 1e-5
natural_algorithm_completion: ELM after full weighted fit; constructive after planned capacity or no admissible candidate; do not burn unused budget
checkpoint_selection: Best complete VAL checkpoint for every method; record actual capacity and entire run cost including work after selected checkpoint
CPU_role: Data preparation, integrity checks, prior calibration, postprocessing. Primary cost-matched learning uses the same GPU type for all methods.
scientific_budget_origin: Empirical single-model PINN resource reference, five independent runs on the same 640 TRAIN cases; quota is feasibility only
reference_rounding_rule: Ceiling of slowest complete PINN training subprocess runtime to a 15-minute GPU-allocation block, giving 4 H200-GPU-hours
reference_host_RAM: 320GiB shared per node across eight workers, proportional 40GiB/worker; not measured individual peak RAM
primary_matching_metric: Resource allowance: one H200, four CPU cores, 40GiB host RAM, at most4 H200-GPU-h and16 CPU core-h
reporting: Best-so-far validation versus allocated resource, with 1/2/4 H200-GPU-h landmarks; intermediate checkpoints belong to one4h optimizer schedule, not independently optimized shorter schedules
budget_origin_notes: Upper total: prior calibration16 + tuning18 +45x4=180 +evaluation reserve60 +two9-minute controls0.30 +initial benchmark0.0028. This arithmetic is not the scientific justification.
additional_comparability_note: Archived PINN supplies a cost reference only; old PINN accuracy is auxiliary because its input representation and sampling/loss differ from this nine-family protocol.
reference_precision_note: Archived PINN used float32, matmul TF32 disabled and cuDNN TF32 enabled; current nine-family protocol disables both TF32 paths. PINN is a cost anchor, not a newly controlled accuracy comparison.
resource_accounting: Allocated H200-hours and CPU-core-hours are reported separately. Peak CUDA allocation and host RSS are observations, not equal-work metrics or VRAM caps.
